pages.title: Roasts
pages.text: Each roast adds 1 minute of another effect:$(li)$(item)Light$(): Slow Falling$(li)$(item)Medium$(): Haste$(li)$(item)Dark$(): Strength$(br2)Milk adds 30 seconds of Regeneration, and a syrup a minute of its effect. Cups stack to 16, only with the same kind.
